text:
andrea-infra: OK team, kicking off South America cluster bring-up for a new inference fleet. Primary asks: GPU quota (prod + staging), network priming, and a cost fallback plan. Need to land quota + basic networking by EOW.

mike-sre: I can own the quota ticket. question: do we want staging on preemptible/spot to save $$? :thinking:

sophia-ml: staging ok on spot for perf tuning. prod must be reserved/committed. also call out NVLink topology for shard tests.

lia-bizops: I'll do a quick cost delta between reserved H100 vs A100 on-demand. Want committed % options.

andrea-infra: rough targets: staging = 40 GPUs, prod initial reserve = 120 GPUs. Preferred hardware: H100 where available, fallback A100-80GB. If cloud quotas don't allow H100, we may mix types.

jason-net: Network checklist: VPC CIDR proposal 10.10.0.0/16. Need peering with existing prod VPC, artifact registry egress, and optional private interconnect if RDMA required. Will validate MTU + routes.

mike-sre: quota request template I'm going to use (will paste into cloud request):

```
project: redwood-inference-southamerica
region: southamerica-1
resource: GPUs (H100 / A100-80GB)
requested: 120 (prod), 40 (staging)
purpose: Dedicated inference capacity for customer workloads + staging for performance validation
justification: SLA-backed production capacity for inference; required for regional compliance and latency SLOs
timeline: need capacity by 2024-08-01 for staged rollout
contact: mike-sre@redwood.ai, andrea-infra@redwood.ai
```

quota-bot: Ticket created: Q-4231 (https://cloud.console/quota/Q-4231)

sophia-ml: Ops image we need: rwd-inference-2024-07-gpu (CUDA 12.1, NCCL 2.18). Add note about driver/kernel requirements for H100.

andrea-infra: Good call. Also add KMS key id and audit logging requirement to the ticket (customer compliance).

mike-sre: filing reservation request for commit options. Lia, I'll need a cost SKU to attach to the capex. ETA for ticket: 6h.

lia-bizops: early estimate: 120 H100 reserved 1yr ~ $REDACTED/month. Quick cost-savings idea: reserve 80 and run 40 on spot until demand grows. I'll share spreadsheet DM.

jason-net: FYI, prototype network in staging account shows RDMA needs MTU 9000; default 1500 breaks NCCL perf. I can push MTU + route changes once we have VPC CIDR locked.

andrea-infra: Action checklist for handoff once quota approved:
- mike-sre: escalate quota/reservation and attach ops image + KMS
- jason-net: finalize interconnect vs peering and MTU config
- sophia-ml: smoke test model shard + NVLink perf in staging (provide small eval set)
- lia-bizops: finalize commit sizing and CAPEX approval path
- andrea-infra: coordinate deployment window and runbook signoff

mike-sre: on it, will post ticket updates here. tagging deploy-bot for CI image bake once quota is green.

deploy-bot: CI bake job queued: rwd-inference-2024-07-gpu -> build-7824

sophia-ml: once staging up, I'll run a 1-node then 4-node sharding perf test and post results.

jason-net: small blocker: cloud provider asked for justification to approve private interconnect. Lia, can you help phrase 1-2 lines on business need in the ticket?

lia-bizops: sure — will add: "Regional SLA & data locality require dedicated low-latency link for inference; necessary for regulatory and latency-sensitive customers."

andrea-infra: thanks all. I'll keep this thread as the single source for approvals and handoff steps. please react to updates rather than DM to keep audit trail. :thumbsup:
